meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 它会把 LazyCodex/Codex 的 bug 转成英文 GitHub issue；若已有同类 issue，则以评论补充证据。它会先复现并查源码，确定由哪个仓库负责，并写明复现步骤与修复建议；只有目标是 openai/codex 且你要求时才提 PR。
howto.when: 当用户要求报告、提交或分类处理 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 等缺陷时触发。

say.text: 给 LazyCodex 的安装报错开个 GitHub issue。
say.note: 它会调查并生成带证据的英文 issue。

say.text: 把这个 Codex CLI 的崩溃整理成 PR 提给 openai/codex。
say.note: 仅当缺陷确属 openai/codex 时才会建 PR。

say.text: 先查查有没有同样的 bug 已提过，没有就新建。
say.note: 它会先搜索现有工单，避免重复提交。

howto.what_en: Turns a LazyCodex/Codex bug report into an English GitHub issue, or comments on an existing one, after checking source to choose the owning repo, with repro and fix guidance. A PR is only created for openai/codex when asked.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug.

say_en.text: Create a GitHub issue for this LazyCodex installation error.
say_en.note: It investigates and creates an evidence-backed English issue.

say_en.text: Turn this Codex CLI crash into a PR against openai/codex.
say_en.note: Only creates a PR if the defect is confirmed in openai/codex.

say_en.text: Check whether this bug was already reported before filing.
say_en.note: It searches existing issues first to avoid duplicates.
